name: 齐论人才管理系统
protocol: OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE S256; client_secret_post; query response mode

roles.name: 面试成员（当前无业务档案读取权限）

policy.legacy_binding: Only an administrator-confirmed local_user_id (original staff_users.id) may bind an existing account.
policy.every_request_authorization: GET issuer/api/v1/me with access token; reject on outage or revoked grants.
policy.logout: Local POST /api/iam/logout ends only the talent session. Central logout revokes all system tokens.
policy.h5: Candidate invitation links and PINs remain independent of staff SSO.

server_configuration.IAM_ENABLED: 1 in production; private values remain server-only
server_configuration.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID: retain existing private scope; never require users to type it

production_acceptance.anonymous_oidc_redirect: verified to the central login page
production_acceptance.offline_access_consent: prompt=consent verified in the production authorization request
production_acceptance.secrets: stored only in private server configuration
